text:
9 Daytime Running Lamps
Combinations of Sidelights and Low Beam automatically turned on when the vehicle is operated, even if it is daylight. Two common variations exist: Scandinavian and Canadian. Indicate in-use vehicle. "Daytime Running Lamps " may exist as separate outputs too besides Low beam and High beam. Also on some cars ( Nissan or VW ) the fog lamps may be used for Daytime Running Lamps Min. 2 White or Yellow Front - symmetrical - as far apart as practicable
